title: passovia pyrifolia
intro: Passovia pyrifolia, commonly known as the Passion Flower, is a type of flowering vine native to the Americas. The plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include treating anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, as well as providing relief from pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Passovia pyrifolia are attributed to its sedative and anti-anxiety properties, which can be achieved through its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. These bioactive constituents, including harman, harmine, and passiflorine, contribute to the plant's ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress.
